_comment: Coverage floors enforced by scripts/check-coverage.ts. Baselined from the 'All files' row of bun test --coverage (functions 83.35%, lines 73.11% as of 2026-05-27, with the new scripts/*.ts files contributing low coverage because their CLI main() runners shell out to bun and aren't unit-tested) and set slightly below to absorb measurement noise. The ratchet only goes UP — raise these as coverage improves; lowering them implies tests were deleted and needs a tracker reference in the diff.
